name: nacos-ai-registry
description: Discover, manage and use Nacos AI Registry resources from your agent.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to your Nacos AI Registry to discover and manage Skills, connect existing MCP tools, and use remote Agents. Includes an interactive resource center. Requires Python 3.11+ and a local desktop executor; configure your registry connection after installation.
defaultPrompt: 在本地 Codex 中初始化 Nacos AI Registry，先检查插件工具是否可用。
打开 Nacos 资源中心。
查找 Nacos 中可用的技能、MCP 工具和远端 Agent。
